caption: The drawing presents three distinct objects, each appearing to be a fireplace tool. On the left, there is a long-handled shovel with a wide, flat, and slightly curved black blade, and a rounded, gold-colored handle with a decorative knob at the top. In the center, there is a frontal view of a handle, colored gold, featuring a finial-like oval top, a series of cylindrical segments, and a round base, with two black appendages extending downward. On the right, there is a pair of tongs, also with a long shaft and a handle similar to the other two objects—gold and rounded with a segmented appearance—connected to black, narrow, curved arms ending in rounded grips. There are two small rulers marked "INCHES" at the bottom left and below the center object for scale. The drawing is done on a beige or off-white background with visible pencil and colored shading for detail and dimension. The artist’s name, "Hans Korsch," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Fire Tongs and Shovel
